claims.value: Light = AUG-nLuc-PP7 reporter RNA (no repeat control); Medium = +1CGG100-nLuc-PP7 reporter RNA; Heavy = (GGGGCC)70-nLuc-PP7 reporter RNA
claims.evidence: Channel map (rule 6), two explicit sources that agree: (1) Methods: "Light SILAC was used for AUG-nLuc-PP7, medium SILAC +1CGG100-nLuc-PP7, and heavy SILAC was used for 1(+) (GGGGCC)70-nLuc-PP7 reporter"; Results: "AUG-nLuc-PP7 reporter was grown in light and CGG-nLuc-PP7 reporter was grown in medium amino acids"; Fig 1D legend light (Lys-0/Arg-0), medium (Lys-4/Arg-6). (2) Dataset EV1 PD column headers in all four Raw MS sheets: "F1: Light, Sample, AUG" / "F1: Medium, Sample, CGG" / "F1: Heavy, Sample, GGGGCC" (or "No Repeat"/"CGG Repeat"/"GGGGCC Repeat"), with ratios labelled "(CGG)/(AUG)" and "(GGGGCC)/(AUG)". The capture construct is the same in every channel: each reporter plasmid co-transfected with PCP-NLS-3xFLAG and immunoprecipitated with anti-FLAG M2 beads; the PCP bait protein ("Indranil Bait" FASTA entry) is quantified in all three channels of every run. Custom characteristics column (spec "Extending Templates"; campaign precedent PXD018305 characteristics[bait]).

Methods: "For ISR activation, cells were seeded similarly and transfected for 19 h, followed by 5 h of treatment with 2 uM Thapsigargin"; Results: "cells were treated with 2 uM TG 5 h before the IP". No vehicle is stated for the no-TG IPs, so controls are "untreated" (rule 4). Run assignment: peptide overlap places 0413/0464 on the "No TG" sheets and 0465/0508 on the "+TG" sheets (run_map, Jaccard >= 0.979 on the diagonal); raw-header sample names agree: 0413 "3xSILAC", 0464 "3xWCE IP#2", 0465 "3xStress#2", 0508 "3xStress#1". OLS NCIT:C128634 label "Thapsigargin". Dose (2 uM) and duration (5 h) are not encoded in a column.

Paper: "n = 2 independent experiments" (Fig 1E/F), "Bar graphs represent average of two biological replicates"; Methods "Three 10-cm dishes were used per condition", each reporter in its own SILAC-labelled cultures, so every (bait, treatment, experiment) is an independent culture. Numbering follows the acquisition-time sample names in the raw headers ("3xSILAC" = first no-TG IP, "3xWCE IP#2", "3xStress#1" = 0508, "3xStress#2" = 0465). Dataset EV1 orders the +TG sheets the other way round (+TG (1) = 0465, +TG (2) = 0508); see limitations.
One source per (reporter bait, treatment, independent experiment); bait, treatment and replicate as in the claims above. G4C2 abbreviates the (GGGGCC)70 reporter.

limitations: characteristics[biological replicate] for the +TG runs: the raw-file sample names ("3xStress#1" = 0508, "3xStress#2" = 0465) are used. Dataset EV1 sheet order and Figure 1F/source-data "repeat_1"/"repeat_2" put 0465 first (+TG (1)) and 0508 second (+TG (2)). Replicate numbers are only identifiers within a group, but which no-TG and +TG IPs were done side by side is not stated; 0464 ("3xWCE IP#2") and 0465 ("3xStress#2") were acquired consecutively.

Channel map evidence is the Methods text plus the Proteome Discoverer channel headers in Dataset EV1. The .pdStudy/.pdResult files that hold the PD sample annotation were not deposited (PRIDE submission type PARTIAL), and the PCP bait protein is present in all three channels by design, so no data-internal marker distinguishes the reporter channels independently of these labels.

comment[alkylation reagent] = not available: no alkylation step or reagent is described in the paper or PRIDE protocol (only DTT reduction), yet every search used fixed Carbamidomethyl C and PRIDE lists "iodoacetamide derivatized residue" among identified PTMs. The search parameter is encoded as deposited; the reagent is not asserted.

characteristics[developmental stage] = not available: Cellosaurus gives AG "Fetus" for HEK293T, but no EFO "fetal stage" term was found in OLS (searches "fetal stage", "fetus", "foetal stage" in EFO). characteristics[age] = not available (no numeric age).

characteristics[ancestry category] = not available: Cellosaurus CVCL_0063 has no population annotation. characteristics[passage number] = not available: only "5-6 passages" in SILAC medium are stated, not the passage number of the line.

Search databases differ: 0413/0464/0465 searched against "Indranil_Todd.fasta; uniprot-HSapien_Reviewed_08022017.fasta", 0508 against "Indranil_Todd.fasta; uniprot-HSapien-reviewed 08292018.fasta" (explains the OX= headers only in sheet "+TG (2)"). Search parameters (enzyme, tolerances, modifications) are otherwise identical, so one header set covers all runs. The paper and PRIDE name only the 08-02-2017 database.
PD workflow description says "Ion trap-detected HCD spectra" (template text) but the raw method summary records Orbitrap MS2 detection at 15K; the raw file is used for comment[ms2 mass analyzer].

The GGGGCC (heavy) channel is annotated because it was measured and quantified in every run, although the paper analyses mainly the CGG interactome ("the GGGGCC interactome will be the focus of a separate manuscript").
Treatment dose (2 uM thapsigargin) and timing (5 h before IP) are recorded here only; no template column carries them.
Independent review is external (REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL); this manifest was not self-approved.
